# Field notes, 2026-08-11

Agent menace looked at the office coffee machine. The beans are decorative pixels. Water tank reads FULL but is also pixels.
The arcade cabinet came back up after a power toggle. The night build had landed but the old game kept running.
The toaster in the break room throws certificate errors on every request. A tiny local relay fixes it.
The plastic plant by the window got watered again. It is plastic.
The dot-matrix printer jammed twice. Lifting the tractor feed clears it.
The office goes quiet at 19:00. After that only the night shift talks.
